values.headline: PH stocks fall, peso closes down at 57.58 vs US dollar
values.subheadline: LOCAL shares dipped Wednesday amid sluggish trading, as investors remained on the sidelines due to global uncertainties, including the tions approaching Aug. 1 tariff negotiations deadline with the U.S.

values.headline: Malampaya contractor tax part of gov't profit share–SC
values.subheadline: THE Supreme Court has ruled that the government's Malampaya Gas-to-Power Project includes the income taxes of contractors.

values.headline: Subway project faces delays on ROW issues
values.subheadline: THE Department of Transportation (DOTr) is accelerating construction of the P488.5-billion Metro Manila Subway Project, despite delays primarily caused by right-of-way issues.

values.headline: 26% exports growth cut June trade deficit
values.subheadline: PHILIPPINE merchandise exports surged 26.1 percent year-on-year in June, 2024, leading to a smaller trade deficit for the month, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) said Wednesday.

values.headline: AI, climate change, social changes threaten PH jobs
values.subheadline: TECHNOLOGICAL developments particularly in AI, might soon outcompete humans in most tasks, putting workers' jobs at risk more than ever, he said.
